title: Kissed Crisp Croatian Shrimp Skewers
description: A Croatian dish featuring jumbo shrimp, this recipe brings a fatty and crisp twist to a classic brunch option, making it gluten-free friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the jumbo shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the shrimp in the preheated oven for 8 minutes or until they turn pink and are cooked through.
Remove the shrimp from the oven and sprinkle with lemon zest and chopped parsley.
Serve the shrimp skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
